classification.difficultyReason: Read the histogram into a table, form products and cumulative frequencies, then calculate statistics using observed extremes.

inlines.text: The frequency histogram shows the number of drinks sold each day.
Complete the frequency table then calculate the summary statistics

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6, histogram to the right of the completion table
spec.description: A frequency histogram with touching bars, positive-direction axis arrows, a square coordinate grid, horizontal Drinks label and vertically rotated Frequency label.
spec.mathematics: Drinks values 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 have frequencies 0, 5, 7, 4, 2. Bars span 6.5–7.5, 7.5–8.5, 8.5–9.5 and 9.5–10.5, with heights 5, 7, 4 and 2. The displayed vertical axis is at x=5.5. Horizontal grid positions are 5.5 through 11.5 in steps of 1; vertical grid positions are 0 through 8 in steps of 1. Labelled horizontal ticks are 6–10 and labelled vertical ticks are 1–7. O is an origin label, not an observed drinks value.
spec.answerVisibility: The histogram is permanently visible given information. The completed table and summary statistics remain in controlled answer fields.

inlines.text: Read each frequency from the histogram. Multiply the drinks value by its frequency, then keep a running total of frequencies.

answer.worked: The greatest frequency is 7 days, corresponding to 8 drinks. The mode is 8 drinks.

The observed minimum is 7 drinks; 6 has frequency 0.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Range}&=10-7\\\text{Range}&=3\text{ drinks}\end{align*}$$

Enter the drinks values and their frequencies in one-variable statistics and read $\bar{x}$. Check using the completed table:

$$\begin{align*}\sum f&=18\\\sum fx&=147\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\sum fx}{\sum f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{147}{18}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{49}{6}\\\bar{x}&\approx8.17\end{align*}$$

The mean is $\frac{49}{6}$ drinks per day, approximately $8.17$ drinks per day.

The calculator gives $\mathrm{med}=8$. Check the two middle observations:

$$\begin{align*}M_p&=\frac{18+1}{2}\\M_p&=9.5\end{align*}$$

Positions 9 and 10 both contain 8: the cumulative frequency is 5 through 7 drinks and 12 through 8 drinks.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{8+8}{2}\\\text{Median}&=8\text{ drinks}\end{align*}$$
